notes: Algorithm measured on AE 2026 8 bpc: tiles anchored at the layer's top-left; each tile = the mean of its PREMULTIPLIED RGBA pixels rounded to nearest (bit-exact up to 1 level), or with Sharp Colors (AE 3) the tile's LAST pixel (bottom-right: x = tile end - 1, y = tile end - 1), NOT its centre as Adobe's docs say (exact on all 800 tiles of 40x20). Tiles span [i*W/n, (i+1)*W/n) exactly, fractions included (measured on the 13x7 held-out reference, 640x360): a tile's mean weights each pixel by the share of it inside the tile, and a pixel straddling two tiles is the coverage-weighted mix of both tile means (area sampling); identical to whole-pixel tiles when W is a multiple of n. Sharp Colors on non-divisible sizes is not measured (last whole pixel of the tile). Block counts are rounded to integers (AE integer sliders) and clamped to >= 1; counts above the layer size give 1-px tiles (identity). 4 separable passes, RGBA8 premultiplied intermediates: 0 = horizontal chunk mean over [x, min(x+K, tile end)), 1 = horizontal tile mean from the chunks, 2/3 = same vertically; K = 1 (copy) while a tile is <= 128 px, else ceil(sqrt(tile length)) so a pass stays <= ~max(128, 2*sqrt(L)) texelFetches (1 tile on 30000 px: 174). Sharp Colors: passes 0/2 copy, 1/3 fetch the last column/row (bit-exact). The intermediate rounding gives +-1 level vs AE's single rounding. Not reproduced: AE 4 Compositing Options (effect opacity / effect masks). The grid is computed on the canvas size, so keep the Rive node's `pad` at 0 (Mosaic never spills outside the layer).

measured.model_checks: offline vs exact numpy model (premultiplied tile mean / last pixel, floor(x*n/W) tiles) for 1x1, 2x1, 3x2, 4x3, 5x1, 13x7, 640x360, 1000x500 (chunked K>1 paths included) and sharp 13x7, 7x3, 1x1, 4000x4000: mean <= 0.049, max 1; Rive vs offline on 1x1, 3x2, 13x7, sharp 7x3, 2.6x1.2: mean <= 0.012, max 1

verified.by: independent check 2026-10-04 (fxlib check --rive --holdout, AE 2026 8 bpc refs)
verified.note: held out 13x7 (non-divisible tiles) exposed the tile-boundary rule: fixed on that setting (area sampling of fractional tiles), so it is no longer an independent check. Before the fix: mean 0.688 %, 2.659 % px > 8, max 193; after: mean 0.026 %, 0 % px > 8, max 2 (offline, wgpu).
